We are recruiting a fully funded PhD student at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

to join our newly funded NWO KIC project FEDERATE on Privacy-Preserving AI and Knowledge Graphs for Energy Digital Twins.

The project sits at the intersection of:

* Knowledge Graphs and Ontologies

* Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (especially forgetting, uniform interpolation, Craig interpolation, and concept interpolation)

* Machine Unlearning

* Privacy-Preserving AI

* Digital Twins for the Energy Transition

We are looking for a motivated candidate with interests in AI, semantic technologies, machine learning, or knowledge representation.
